text:
Maya (People Ops): Heads up — Raj's requested start date moved up to 2026-05-01. Need to lock work auth for payroll/benefits. @Raj can you confirm current visa/work-permit status and biometrics date? :spiral_calendar:

Raj Patel: Hey — good question. My STEM OPT EAD was approved, card mailed; tracking says delivery 2026-04-28. Biometrics done 2026-02-10 at NYC ASC. I don't have I-797; the EAD is my current work auth. Want me to upload photos?

Maya (People Ops): Yes please upload clear photos (front/back) of the EAD and SSN card to the HR portal. Also, if you have your USCIS receipt number put it in the notes. We'll need that to pre-clear payroll.

Raj Patel: Uploaded both to portal just now (files: EAD_front.jpg, EAD_back.jpg, SSN_card.jpg). No I-797 receipt; employer didn't give one for OPT.

Anna (Eng Manager): Thanks — from team side, perfect. Legal confirmed EAD is acceptable. If H-1B gets filed/transferred later we may need to re-run onboarding checks but that's later. :thumbsup: 

Paul (Payroll): Quick checklist from payroll: SSN, DOB, current address, EAD expiration date, and either I-9 documents or portal uploads. If docs are present by 5/1 we can activate payroll same day. If not, we'll have to hold pay until employment eligibility is verified. Please email payroll@redwood.com with subject `New Hire Docs - Raj Patel`.

Raj Patel: Done — emailed payroll with attachments. EAD expiry 2027-04-27. DOB 1996-08-14.

hr-bot: Automated reminder — I-9 verification required within 3 business days of start. Bring originals to office or complete remote verification using the vendor link: https://redwood.example/hr/i9. Failure to verify will delay pay. :warning:

Maya (People Ops): Two administrative notes: 1) Benefits eligibility — benefits begin first of month after 30 days of continuous employment. With a 2026-05-01 start, benefits effective 2026-06-01. 2) Relocation/expense: if claiming relocation, please submit signed addendum + receipts to people-ops@redwood.com before your 1st payroll run.

Raj Patel: Clarified — benefits start 6/1, got it. Submitted signed addendum for relocation in portal (reloc_agreement.pdf).

Maya (People Ops): Perfect, thanks. Final item — background check completed? I see provisional clear. If any issues, legal will flag. Otherwise we are green to proceed. :white_check_mark:

Raj Patel: Background cleared yesterday. All set from my side. Excited to join — see you May 1! :party-parrot:
